internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 10:28 UTC, the ad service triggered a high latency alert (p95 latency reached 1.8 seconds). Initial diagnosis identified CPU resource exhaustion as the root cause, with CPU utilization peaking at 98%. This was supported by the recent activation of the adHighCpu flag. Error injection and memory leak hypotheses were refuted based on low error rates and lack of relevant logs.

At 10:48 UTC, the mitigation action to disable the adHighCpu flag was approved and executed. Post-action monitoring confirmed recovery with latency returning to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds). The incident was resolved promptly without customer impact.

Key timeline:
- 10:28:23 Alert received
- 10:48:07 Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 10:48:14 Flag disabled and recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and continue to monitor the service to prevent recurrence.
